$comment: Calls to interpolate, judged by both editors alike: a Kotlin template in the format, which Kotlin fills before interpolate sees it (interpolate-template); placeholders miscounted against the values (interpolate-placeholders); each %s placeholder judged by where it lands and what the value is (unsafe-interpolation); and the format read as HTML. The format is the one of kotlin.json.

issues.message: interpolate throws IllegalArgumentException here: the markup has 2 %s placeholders and 1 value is given. listOf(a, b) is one value: write its elements out to pass them as the values.

%s, %s

", a, b)
